label: Gmail
description: Search and read mail, read a whole conversation, and send mail from the connected Google account.

auth.guide:
Athena does not ship a Google client: an app given away as source cannot keep one secret, so you make your own once and it stays yours.

1. In the Google Cloud console, create or pick a project.
2. Under APIs & Services, Library, turn on Gmail.
3. Under the consent screen, pick External and add yourself as a test user. Google shows an "unverified app" page for a client you made yourself; that is expected.
4. Under Credentials, create a client of the Desktop app kind. Copy its client id and client secret.
5. Paste both here and press Connect. Your browser opens Google's page; the answer comes back to this computer only, on a port that closes as soon as it is used.

Athena asks to read your mail and to send mail, nothing else: never to delete mail, never your contacts or your calendar. Sending stays off until a twin needs it.

To take it back: https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, or Disconnect here, which also tells Google to forget the permission.

tools.name: search_mail
tools.description: Search the connected mailbox; returns sender, subject, date and a snippet per message.

tools.name: read_mail
tools.description: Read one message by id; returns its headers and plain-text body.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one conversation by its thread id, oldest message first; returns each message's sender, recipients, date, subject, message id and plain-text body.

tools.name: send_mail
tools.description: Send a mail from the connected account to allowed recipients; with thread_id and in_reply_to it is a reply inside that conversation.
